test_3.query: What are the dimensions and excavation method of the Kailasa temple at Ellora?

evidence.text: The court of the Kailasa temple is cut down at right angles to the front of the rock and more than 90 yards in depth. The rock-cut spire of the main temple rises to a height of 96 feet above the court floor.

The entire monolithic temple was excavated by cutting deep vertical trenches into the living basaltic trap rock from above, isolating a central mass of stone which was then carved into the vimana, hall, and monolithic courtyards.
